channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jordan Hawkins | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jordan Hawkins from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Willie Green on Jordan Hawkins
item.description:
Willie Green on #Pelicans SG Jordan Hawkins showing his significant potential during stretches of his two-year #NBA career:

“You go back to last season, when he had moments where he was the best player on the floor. Go back to the early part of this season, and the same thing.”

Willie Green on Jordan Hawkins, Mar 14, 2025. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Jordan Hawkins
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:CJ McCollum on Jordan Hawkins (24 pts, 8/12 FGs at Portland):

“He was huge. He had one of the best training camps I've seen in my 12 (NBA) years. He's gotten a lot better with his decision-making, his shot balance, shot credibility, his ability to finish around the basket.”

CJ McCollum on Jordan Hawkins, Oct 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Jose Alvarado on Jordan Hawkins
item.description:
Jose Alvarado on Jordan Hawkins' progress:

“He got his feet wet with his first year. He’s putting it all together. The game is slowing down for him. He’s going to be really good for us this year.”

Jose Alvarado on Jordan Hawkins, Oct 4, 2024. Source: x.com.
